source_access: Descriptions are based on pinned bundled documentation, with official entity source URLs. The build does not download or certify every live page. The cached IFC4X3 documentation uses a historical documentation hostname; the source_url field points to the current RELEASE publication.

IFC2X3.IfcBeam.note: The full buildingSMART definition states that the beam need not be load bearing; the bundled opening paragraph only contains the ISO definition.

IFC2X3.IfcStructuralItem.note: The bundled description contains only a malformed heading. The replacement uses the official entity definition, not another IFC version's definition.

IFC4X3_ADD2.IfcAlignment.note: The opening sentence refers to three concepts without defining them. The replacement uses the official definition's linear positioning and infrastructure layout explanation.
